instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE to perform a simply supported beam analysis under a uniformly distributed load:

1. Part: 3D Deformable Solid, Extrusion
   - Sketch a 10 mm x 10 mm rectangle in the Y-Z plane (Y from 0 to 10, Z from 0 to 10)
   - Extrude along the global X-axis to length 200 mm
   - This creates a beam with cross-section 10 mm x 10 mm and span 200 mm

2. Property:
   - Material Steel: E = 210000 MPa, nu = 0.3
   - Solid Homogeneous section

3. Assembly: Create an instance.

4. Step: Static, General, named Step-Load.

5. Load:
   - Create RP-1 at the geometric center of the left end face (X=0, Y=5 mm, Z=5 mm) and couple it kinematically to that end face
   - Create RP-2 at the geometric center of the right end face (X=200 mm, Y=5 mm, Z=5 mm) and couple it kinematically to that end face
   - RP-1: U1 = U2 = U3 = 0, UR2 = UR3 = 0 (pinned support, allow UR1 rotation about beam axis)
   - RP-2: U2 = U3 = 0, UR2 = UR3 = 0 (roller support, allow U1 axial motion and UR1 rotation)
   - Apply Pressure = 0.1 MPa downward on the beam top surface (the face at Y=10 mm, equivalent to q = 1 N/mm)

6. Mesh:
   - Global seed size: 5 mm
   - Element type: C3D8R

7. Job: Create Job-Beam and submit for solving.

8. Visualization:
   - Query U2 (deflection) at the bottom midpoint of the span (X=100 mm, Y=0 mm, Z=5 mm)
   - Query maximum Mises stress at the midspan section (X ≈ 100 mm)

9. Save:
   - Model: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Beam.cae
   - Results: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Beam.odb
